about: Every number the speaking feedback rules (src/lib/speech-feedback.ts) and its two evals use. Job 10-speaking-feedback, statements 10, 11 and 22. Provisional until risk test 3 measures them on real learner clips (docs/factory-and-risk-tests-plan.md).

goldenSet.source: PRD section 8, speaking feedback quality: 30 golden cases, (transcript, target) to expected feedback class, at 90 percent or more

wordErrorRate.source: PRD section 8, STT accuracy on learner speech: a 50 clip non native test set, target word error rate below 25 percent

reviewerAgreement.source: Risk test 3's bar: the feedback agrees with the native reviewer on at least 85 percent of clips
